recipes.name: OptiScaler DLSS 5
recipes.summary: Hooks the upscaler the game already has (DLSS, FSR 2+ or XeSS) and runs the DLSS 5 model on its output.
details: OptiScaler loads through a free system DLL name (winmm.dll, version.dll, ...) or OptiScaler.asi next to an ASI loader.
Turn DLSS (or FSR/XeSS) on in the game's graphics settings. OptiScaler's menu opens with the Insert key.

recipes.name: RenoDX DLSS 5 (ReShade add-on)
recipes.summary: ReShade add-on that runs DLSS 5 on the game's own DLSS calls.
details: ReShade is installed as dxgi.dll with add-on support; the add-on is configured in ReShade.ini [RenoDX.DLSS5].
Turn DLSS on in the game's graphics settings. The ReShade overlay opens with the Home key.

recipes.name: DLSS5-Feeder + RenoDX DLSS 5
recipes.summary: For games without DLSS: the Feeder builds the DLSS request from ReShade depth and estimated motion vectors.
details: Motion vectors are estimated by a ReShade shader, so fast motion can ghost a little.
Turn MSAA/SSAA off in the game. The ReShade overlay opens with the Home key.

recipes.name: DLSS5-Feeder + OptiScaler DLSS 5
recipes.summary: Alternative for games without DLSS: OptiScaler DLSS 5 is the neural consumer of the Feeder's DLSS request.
details: OptiScaler runs after the Feeder's DLAA evaluate (pre-SR off) on the Feeder's private D3D12 device.

recipes.name: DLSS5-Feeder 32-bit helper + RenoDX DLSS 5
recipes.summary: For 32-bit games: the 32-bit Feeder hands every frame to a 64-bit helper (host64) that runs DLSS 5, because NVIDIA ships NGX only as 64-bit code.
details: The first frame starts host64\dlss5-feed-host64.exe by itself; it closes with the game.
The neural consumer's panel lives in the helper: ReShade overlay (Home) > Add-ons > DLSS 5 Feed > Show the DLSS 5 panel in-game.
Only DLAA is possible on this route; expect a lower frame rate than a 64-bit game.

recipes.name: FiveM Legacy: DLSS5-Feeder + RenoDX DLSS 5
recipes.summary: Installs into FiveM.app\plugins: ReShade as d3d11.dll (the only name FiveM loads), the in-process Feeder and RenoDX DLSS 5.
details: GTA V files are never touched. FiveM blocks ReShade 5+ until its crash-risk acknowledgement is in CitizenFX.ini.
In game: Home opens ReShade; the motion shader must stay above DLSS 5 Feed (AKENO sets this order).
